description: ol-not-a-place (issue #156): the runtime's guard for a nested-place assignment target (`count :nums[1] = 3` parses as a `Call` with callee `count` whose argument is itself a `Place`) reconciled to the FULL target surface text (`count :nums[1]`), matching the semantic checker's `not-a-place-nested-and-infix` fixture's `count :nums[1]` case and the same source-slicing rule (`not-a-place-text.ts`). The leading `:nums = [1 2 3]` assignment keeps this fixture focused on `ol-not-a-place` alone, without also tripping `ol-undefined-var` on the `:nums` read. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
